candidates.original_description: Reconcile successful feature-branch capabilities with protected main and actual application consumers
candidates.original_evidence: Commands PR #1 merged main; many Context/RI/validation/worker increments feature-published only
candidates.original_acceptance: Build exact Git lineage and capability matrix; identify complete dependencies, destination behavior/tests and safe bounded integration groups; never bulk merge Qwen/experiment ancestry
candidates.rationale: Commands subset superseded by verified main integration; remaining feature capability adoption needs destination-specific dependencies and tests. The initial matrix is not completion of all promotion work.

candidates.original_description: Inventory repeated domain semantics and utility implementations across apps, tools, Context, agents and runtime
candidates.original_evidence: Project grew rapidly across vertical slices
candidates.original_acceptance: Show actual overlapping code paths and tests; identify one canonical owner, migration/caller compatibility and measurable deletion/ergonomics benefit; avoid speculative base classes
candidates.rationale: Large-module facts are qualified; duplicated domain semantics are still a hypothesis. Use existing module-size investigation and owner audit, not automatic utility extraction.

candidates.original_description: Establish a reusable, model-neutral observability/event/tracing contract if the present module is fragmented
candidates.original_evidence: User reports mostly-empty observability package; existing evidence and usage, per-run logs and scientific receipts are fragmented
candidates.original_acceptance: Inventory `observability`, `evidence`, `usage`, model-serving, ToolRunner, WorkCycle, experiments; map correlation/events/spans/OTel/retention/redaction; define smallest coherent production contract and first consumers before implementation
candidates.rationale: Starter report of mostly-empty observability is contradicted by existing Evidence/usage source. Amend research premise, preserve deferred canonical boundaries.

candidates.original_description: Unified end-to-end agent trace and cost/time visibility
candidates.original_evidence: 19–28 Qwen experiments repeatedly lacked paid Codex coordination cost, active supervision time, full GPU/RAM/energy
candidates.original_acceptance: Specify trace scope across task, model request, Tool, source edit, validation, review, publication; what is locally measureable versus unavailable; sensitive data capture control and queryable timeline; tests/OTel compatibility
candidates.rationale: Concrete cross-layer join/loss map adds evidence; paid supervisor time/hardware energy/account-wide costs remain unknown. No global Trace design selected.

candidates.original_description: Verify Qwen thinking, template/tool protocol, quantization, KV cache and context against official recommendations
candidates.original_evidence: Current Qwen3.8-27B UD-IQ4_XS 32K q4 KV thinking-off, mixed quality and Context failures
candidates.original_acceptance: Source-level model/llama.cpp configuration audit, full raw Tool round-trip, same-model controlled thinking baseline and hardware feasibility; no new RI task during reconnaissance
candidates.rationale: Serving/protocol/thinking controls exist, but official recommendation audit and matched model configuration experiments are not performed here. Historical failures do not isolate quantization/model reasoning cause. No new inference authority.

candidates.original_description: Make specialized coding harnesses usable through common governed boundaries
candidates.original_evidence: Qwen Code core/ACP/SDK; Pydantic ExternalToolset; existing Devtools ModelToolDefinition + ToolRunner
candidates.original_acceptance: Compare actual source and approval/edit authorities; propose agent-runtime interface only for demonstrably missing seam; show no competing Checkout/WorkCycle; controlled same-model harness comparison
candidates.rationale: Existing external Codex Agent and native Tool seams remain. Pinned origins/deferred calls identify integration questions, not an accepted generic Agent runtime. B-0029 is SUPERSEDED lineage.

candidates.original_description: Simplify Tool declaration / argument validation / model-facing errors with typed reusable APIs or decorators
candidates.original_evidence: Pydantic AI FunctionToolset/ModelRetry/ToolFailed and current custom Tool schemas
candidates.original_acceptance: Audit current serialization/validation duplications; measure syntax versus semantic errors from native receipts; design transparent decorator/typed wrapper only if decreases boilerplate without changing authority
candidates.rationale: Schema preparation/validation-before-execution already partly exists; typed ergonomic comparison now grounded. ExternalToolset any_schema is not application schema validation.

candidates.original_description: Evaluate simpler model-facing editing without sacrificing exact-source integrity
candidates.original_evidence: Engineering19/22/26/28 Qwen edit refusals and one real-Git EOF host bug; Aider editblock
candidates.original_acceptance: Compare same model/tasks using established `replace_source` and alternative `apply_patch`/search-replace façade; host translates only when semantically exact; retain atomic validation, bytes, version, scope, restoration; do not replace eagerly
candidates.rationale: New pending investigation distinguishes size/anchor/model/host failures and preserves exact authority. No adapter, patch rewrite or comparative run authorized.

candidates.original_description: Make existing graph/map-assisted Context useful rather than merely callable
candidates.original_evidence: Engineering28 native `repository_map` available but never invoked; Aider includes compact repo map with change requests
candidates.original_acceptance: Verify model-facing descriptions, orientation size, Tool overlap, retrieval quality; measure task owner discovery/repeated reads, not forced Tool use; avoid another graph engine
candidates.rationale: Map/Planning/native opt-in navigation are implemented; model availability without invocation is not useful-adoption evidence. Existing CodeGraph proposal retains usability/effectiveness question.

candidates.original_description: Reconcile code/context acquisition duplication and projection costs
candidates.original_evidence: RI, lexical/BM25, graph map, source index, Planning, ContextTools navigation, many repeated source reads
candidates.original_acceptance: Build call graph/ownership; distinguish ranked candidates, native provenance, source authority, disclosure; identify duplication and missing multi-granularity consumers; propose canonical reusable operators only when semantics align
candidates.rationale: ADR-0002/3/4/5 and source distinguish RI, retrieval, Localization, disclosure and source authority. No canonical duplication is proven merely by multiple representations.

candidates.original_description: Durable task-local working state and verified progress/checkpoints
candidates.original_evidence: Qwen misremembered applied edits; 32K Context refills after read/edit/validation; historic memory roadmap
candidates.original_acceptance: Specify exact source/version/edit ledger versus summarizable plan/facts; atomic checkpoints, freshness and restoration; avoid duplicating model traces, repository store or long-term memory
candidates.rationale: Working state/freshness is narrower than long-term Memory. Existing proposal receives advisory separation of task state, transcript and source authority; durable recovery needs domain-owned contract.

candidates.original_description: Unify or explicitly separate experiment orchestration, coding task lifecycle, Checkout and WorkCycle
candidates.original_evidence: Repeated run preparation, frozen oracles, source authentication, review and publication
candidates.original_acceptance: Inspect established pipeline owners and backlog/control interfaces; find duplicated state transitions, absent error path and unnecessary revalidation; preserve approvals and immutability
candidates.rationale: Existing source-specific Checkout/WorkCycle and deterministic experiment controllers are distinct. Shared run mechanics/failed transition audit pending; do not unify by name.

candidates.original_description: Classify, document and delete verified disposable temporary artifacts and reconcile historical duplicate checkout paths
candidates.original_evidence: Existing `.local` evidence, previous `.local/worktrees` concern, generated test/execution scratch
candidates.original_acceptance: Inventory ignored/untracked/branch assets, ownership and sole original evidence; no active processes; reviewed exact-path deletion with hashes/custody and approval; never delete whole `.local` or frozen receipts blindly
candidates.rationale: Existing pending proposal already covers exact-path custody/recovery qualification. ADVISORY update relates exact seed. No deletion/ACL change.

candidates.original_description: Make architecture, production APIs, experiments and backlog navigable from one canonical index
candidates.original_evidence: Many report/README/hand-off snapshots; accepted ADRs and archived experiments span directions
candidates.original_acceptance: Find authoritative indices; cross-link known owners and statuses; remove/confine misleading duplicate status docs; provide developer-facing package capability map and examples
candidates.rationale: Canonical doc map, research README, roadmap and existing active documentation reconciliation own this. Imported draft is not another authority/index. Detailed audit remains unfinished.

candidates.original_description: Audit package layout, public facades, import cycles, naming, typed factories and justified syntactic sugar
candidates.original_evidence: Context planning/retrieval circular-import accommodations, specialized apps and repeated Test fixtures
candidates.original_acceptance: Inspect imports/API/entrypoints, classify intentional layering vs accidental nesting; propose clearer modules/base/decorators where contracts demonstrably stabilize; protect compatibility
candidates.rationale: Module-size investigation captures concrete pressure; import cycles/naming/factory duplication need measured examples before reusable abstraction. No package redesign authorized.

candidates.original_description: Define specialized code-quality/maintenance/research agent roles under existing governance
candidates.original_evidence: User wants proactive duplication, unused capability, documentation and infrastructure stewardship
candidates.original_acceptance: Specify non-mutating detection/reporting roles first, proposal evidence, false-positive control, human-approved fixes, reproducibility and scope; do not create self-modifying general agent prematurely
candidates.rationale: B-0043 already records ResearchAgent/ExperimentManager and worker profiles. Separate report-only maintenance roles lack evaluated detection contracts/consumers; retain as role-specialization hypothesis rather than a generic Agent class or another broad ticket.

candidates.original_description: Assess completeness of cancellation, exception and recovery paths across source/Tool/command/model operations
candidates.original_evidence: Proven host blockers in Engineering25/26 and source identity strictness; Windows subprocess risks
candidates.original_acceptance: Audit transition/error matrix with actual logs, owner recovery, temporary effects, subprocess cleanup and repeated validation; distinguish actual bug from intentionally strict guard
candidates.rationale: Cancellation, semantic repair and uncertain effects have separate canonical children of superseded B-0014. New source/test observations support transition audit, not an asserted global cancellation defect.

candidates.original_description: Keep sibling Learned Intelligence research/catalog independent of Devtools's experiment status
candidates.original_evidence: Prior records mention B-0001–0053 and `src/learned_intelligence`; separate repo from `devtools`
candidates.original_acceptance: Mark cross-project references, imports and intended integration boundaries; do not count sibling source as Devtools production or clear its `.tmp`/scientific evidence during Devtools cleanup
candidates.rationale: Existing charter explicitly separates Learned Intelligence repository/catalogs. Policy requirement is captured; no sibling source inspected, moved or counted. No cross-project ticket invented.
